direct_hw_game_functions.what: crt0 __start: reads 0x800000f4 (BI2 debugger info) and 0x800030e6, writes 0x80000044. Boot-info low memory, not a hardware page. Replace with host entry.
crt0 args setup: relocates argv from BI2 at 0x800000f4+8, writes 0x80000034 (arena hi). Low memory. Replace with host entry.
crt0 pad3 check: reads 0x800030e4, calls OSResetSystem(0,0,0) on combo. Low memory. Drop.

XGXContext::Initialize: mtgqr GQR2=u8, GQR3=u16, GQR4=s8, GQR5=s16 (load and store scale 0), right after GXInit. Only GQR writes in game code. Lifted psq_l and psq_st must honour them; 105 game functions use psq per ppc-special.json.

Raw FIFO, bypasses GX API: BP 0x61 words 0x2402c004 and 0x23000020 plus XF 0x10 reg 0x1006 = 0x84400 after GXSetGPMetric(0x23,0x16), or zeroes to disable. GP perf counters for the hang watchdog. No-op natively.
Indexed mesh after GXBegin (via 8016b384): FIFO sth same u16 three times per vertex when attr mask == 0x122 (three attributes share one index). Index stream at object +0xa0.
Indexed mesh after GXBegin (via 8016b384): FIFO sth or stb per enabled attribute group in mask bits 0x3,0xc,0x30,0x180; object flag 0x40000000 picks u8 over u16 indices.
GXBegin(prim,0,n) then FIFO sth sequential u16 indices per mask bits; caller uses prim 0x90 triangles.
Point sprites as quads: GXBegin(0x80,0,n*4), FIFO stfs pos xyz +- half size, stw colour, stfs uv atlas cell, optional object-to-world transform. Reached from dispatch table 0x803a52b0/0x803a52a0.
Same vertex layout as 8016c7d0 with extra axis vectors from object +0x6c and +0x78 (oriented sprites). Via 8016d464, table 0x803a52c0.
Same layout, sprite list filtered by page byte (u16 id high byte == page, low byte = uv cell), v flipped by 1.0 constant. Via 8016d984, table 0x803a52d0.
Same family, no direct caller (dispatch table 0x803a52e0); per-sprite inputs read through psq with GQR2 then FIFO stfs.
Text glyph blit: GXBegin(0x80,0,4), FIFO s16 x,y,z and u,v per corner; called from text renderer 8016e1c0.
THP frame blit: GXLoadTexObj Y,U,V then GXBegin(0x80,7,4), FIFO s16 x,y,z,u,v quad.
Reads OS bus clock 0x800000f8 directly (/4000 for ms) in disc-read stall watchdog. Low memory, not a hardware page.
Reads 0x800000f8 bus clock to convert OSGetTime deltas to ms. Low memory.
Reads 0x800000f8 bus clock to convert ticks to microseconds. Low memory.

SDK data, not hardware: XGXScreen init takes GXRenderModeObj globals 0x80408120 (NTSC 640x480 interlaced, tvmode 0) and 0x80408378 (MPAL, tvmode 8) directly; PAL uses game table 0x803fe370. Provide these constants.
